covered.label: STIB/MIVB metro (lines 1, 2, 5, 6)
covered.detail: The next couple of metro departures per direction at all 60 stations on lines 1, 2, 5 and 6 are live, tracked departures from STIB/MIVB's own vehicle-tracking feed. Later departures shown after those (up to an hour ahead) come from the printed timetable instead and are marked Scheduled.

covered.label: SNCB/NMBS domestic rail (Gare Centrale/Centraal, Gare du Midi/Zuidstation, Gare de l'Ouest/Weststation)
covered.detail: IC, S-trains, L, P, EuroCity and EuroCity Direct trains at these three stations where metro and national rail share a building, from a second live feed. Shown separately from the metro departures, never merged into one list. If this second feed is briefly unavailable, the metro departures still show and the board is flagged as showing metro only until it recovers.

notCovered.label: Buses (STIB/MIVB, De Lijn, TEC), including rail-replacement buses
International trains (Eurostar, Thalys, TGV, OUIGO, Nightjet, European Sleeper)
notCovered.detail: Not shown - these need a reservation or check-in before boarding, unlike a walk-up domestic or regional train.

stations: 60 metro stations on lines 1, 2, 5 and 6. Three of them - Gare Centrale/Centraal, Gare du Midi/Zuidstation and Gare de l'Ouest/Weststation - also show SNCB/NMBS domestic rail departures alongside the metro.
